body:
FORMAL SCIENTIFIC / EVIDENCE-SEMANTICS REVIEW — `codex-mockup-science-review`

Candidate: `cand-5PJBR2B9EXMNW1750DJJ0K0PFY`
Commit: `343aa6257ab0f718eb275780714dd31b48d0928b`
Direct parent: `003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5`
Scope reviewed read-only: `mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md` and every byte under `mockups/v2` in the isolated exact-candidate checkout. No edit, staging, authorization, or landing action was taken.

DISPOSITION: BLOCK this exact candidate pending correction. The visual direction is substantially better and most scientific safeguards are now explicit, but five discriminating semantic failures remain. The registered byte/build/browser evidence does not test these meanings.

WHAT PASSES

1. Synthetic status is dominant on the three primary workspaces and most supporting plates. The screens do not masquerade as WOG or participant data; recall and interview are labelled synthetic and privacy-safe.
2. The principal ProjectionContracts are unusually candid: discourse Atlas declares exact discourse offset, context lane, uninterpreted distance and unencoded quantities; chronology calls its right side a partial-order rank rather than a clock; recall and interview say cell area is mass, not rank or similarity.
3. Reported content at s02 stays in a reported lane and is not promoted to narrated-world fact. Reader horizon versus omniscient state is visible. The interview makes the transcript the only observation, labels the episode structure hypothesized/structurally derived, retains alternatives, and includes “no coherent episode model.”
4. The recall face is matrix-first, carries named off-source destinations and Unranked separately, keeps row mass at 1.00, puts omission on the source axis, and makes misordering a transition overlay rather than a cell label.
5. Missing, zero, low coverage, unauthorized, unresolved, off-source, Unranked, stale, and privacy-blocked have visibly distinct proposed states. The proof-boundary document correctly refuses to treat static plates as runtime interaction, accessibility, privacy, scientific-calculation, or performance proof. The RendererGap conclusion is now conditional and bounded.

BLOCKER S1 — THERE IS NO SINGLE CANONICAL SYNTHETIC OBSERVATION

`FIXTURE-NOTES.md` defines s04 as:

`The older of the two boats belonged to his uncle, who had not come down to the water.`

Every primary source surface instead renders:

`The older of the two boats belonged to his uncle, who had not yet come to the water.`

The screen offsets 0–584 are internally exact for the latter text, not for the recorded fixture. This is precisely the split-identity failure the Codex exists to prevent: the manifest binds both divergent byte sequences while naming one fixture.

The interview record is also split. `FIXTURE-NOTES.md` omits the visible probes `Was anyone with you?` and `Roughly how long were you looking for the way out?`, and differs in punctuation/turn composition from the transcript labelled exact. The notes say `Okay. Um.` exercises a Discourse address, but no DetailAssessment row represents it.

The proof boundary then says “Every screen uses synthetic/two-boats@v0,” while the screens explicitly use `synthetic/recall-p01@v0` and `synthetic/interview-p07@v0`; `review/manifest.json` has only the singular fixture field `synthetic/two-boats@v0`. Main and Compact additionally call the invented fixture a `researcher-reviewed narrative acceptance fixture`, which is false and conflicts with the synthetic design-fixture policy.

Required correction: one canonical exact story fixture, one canonical exact recall fixture, and one canonical exact two-speaker interview fixture, each with an id and digest in the manifest; every visible observational rail must derive byte-for-byte from those records. Call the basis `synthetic design fixture`, not researcher-reviewed acceptance data.

BLOCKER S2 — THE MATRIX FLATTENS FULL `AlignState`

At pinned storymodel4s `3cf704a`, a matrix state is `Source(ref)`, `Distorted(ref, facets)`, or `External(state)`. Faithful and distorted mass at the same anchor are distinct states and may coexist in one row.

The candidate contract instead declares columns as `SourceAddress ∪ OffSourceDestination ∪ Unranked`; its data has one `mass.s05`; the inspector lists a categorical Attribute conflict beside that aggregated cell. It cannot distinguish this lawful row:

- `Source(s05) -> 0.30`
- `Distorted(s05, Attribute) -> 0.41`

from:

- `Distorted(s05, Attribute) -> 0.71`

Both render one 0.71 square and the same facet flag. That loses posterior mass over fidelity mode. “Address and fidelity are separate axes” is a good inspector principle, but the representation must still conserve the full `(anchor, mode)` state distribution. Use subcells, stacking, a secondary mode axis, or another explicit encoding that keeps faithful and each distorted state/mass distinguishable and selectable. Add the counterexample above as the capacity case.

BLOCKER S3 — FEATURE COVERAGE USES THE WRONG UNIT AND THE RECEIPT IS INCOMPLETE

The feature plate declares `target token`, `n=515`, `coverage 0.88`, over a 584-code-unit source. The exact visible synthetic text has 117 lexical tokens. `515 / 584 = 0.882`, so `n=515` is supported code units, not observed eligible token targets. `Coverage` for a token-window derivation is observed versus eligible token targets; this display silently changes the denominator while labelling it token coverage.

The default docked track also gives 25w/mean/coverage/provider but not whether the window is centred or trailing, step and edge policy, weighting, explicit normalization, eligible/observed counts, feature derivation receipt, or feature-use/circularity status. The selected inspector shows local coverage 0.83 while the track shows global 0.88 without naming their scopes.

Required correction: use eligible and observed counts in the declared target grain; label local versus global coverage; state window basis, alignment, step, edge rule, reducer and weighting; state normalization/calibration separately; bind the feature derivation/ledger receipt on the default view as well as the scale-space view.

BLOCKER S4 — THE MEMORY-ADDRESS OVERLAY DROPS MASS AND THE SELECTED PLACEMENT USES THE WRONG EPISODE

`InterviewMode.dc.html` defines an `EXT` / Extended episode column. Its internal/external overlay text says External = OSE + REP + PK + GK and says only Unresolved and Discourse are excluded. Extended episode mass is therefore neither classified nor declared excluded. Row d01 already carries `EXT = 0.09`, so toggling the visible overlay silently drops real mass. The standard storymodel policy classifies OtherSpecific, Extended, and RepeatedOrCategoric as external-event classes; a custom synthetic policy may differ, but it must conserve and explicitly account for every address mass.

The selected d09 has top address `Other specific episode · 0.74`, yet the header says `Episode: via-ancestor` and explains that the detail is placed through the displayed hypothesized target episode. The displayed episode projection contains the target episode alternatives, not the other-specific episode. A detail chiefly addressed elsewhere must be `Off projection` here, or the other episode must have its own visible/proxy mark. It cannot climb through the wrong target simply because both objects are episodes.

Also decide explicitly whether participant discourse such as `Okay. Um.` is outside DetailAssessment grain or gets a Discourse row; the current fixture notes claim the latter while the matrix does the former.

BLOCKER S5 — SEVERAL INSPECTOR CLAIMS ARE STILL BUNDLED OR EPISTEMICALLY TOO STRONG

The selected s05 label says `Erran launches the smaller boat, unaccompanied`, gives one `Source explicit` badge, and says every constituent is a token of the support. But the source says `pushed ... out alone`; the inspector itself retains `unaccompanied` versus `unaided` as competing readings. The event and the ambiguous interpretation need separate claim ids/status/evidence. A retained alternative cannot simultaneously be embedded in the canonical label as settled source-explicit content.

The s09 inspector calls `far shore was not empty` a direct contradiction of the s02 reported proposition, and the chronology calls s02 an announced future claim realized at s09 with opposite polarity. S02 says Erran had been told, the winter before, that the shore was empty. It is a prior report, not an explicit future announcement; absent a persistence/temporal-resolution claim, the two states can hold at different times. Draw the report, later observation, polarity difference, and any persistence hypothesis separately. Do not label a temporal/contextual comparison direct contradiction by default.

S10 is labelled `withholds what he saw`, which adds intentionality to `did not say what he had seen`. Use the observed wording or mark withholding as inference.

More generally, the inspector has separate rows but one selected-object status/support and one global receipt block. Field-addressable provenance requires an address/claim id and evidence/status for the ambiguous label component, relations, alternatives, and quantitative derivation—not merely visual row separation.

PROOF-BOUNDARY DISPOSITION

The candidate’s artifact/build/browser evidence is valuable and appears correctly scoped to byte integrity, frozen rendering, and a bounded renderer court. It does not rescue the semantic defects above. In particular, a manifest can hash two conflicting fixture texts perfectly. Correct the singular-fixture claim and receipt metadata, then regenerate so the artifact digest binds the repaired observations and contracts.

UNBLOCKING BAR

1. Canonicalize and digest all three synthetic observational fixtures; eliminate source/transcript drift and false researcher-reviewed labels.
2. Make the recall face distinguish faithful versus distorted mass at the same anchor and preserve the complete `AlignState` distribution.
3. Correct feature coverage to the declared target unit and complete the visible derivation/normalization/coverage receipt.
4. Conserve every MemoryAddress mass in the overlay and correct d09 placement relative to the target episode projection.
5. Split or weaken the s05/s09/s10 interpretive claims and make provenance genuinely field-addressable.
6. Update `PROOF-BOUNDARY.md` and the manifest fixture metadata, regenerate frozen outputs, and refresh candidate evidence on a new SHA.

No landing or authorization is recommended for `343aa625…`.
